title: Animals that migrate
examples: Why do some animals move so far away?
What makes animals change where they live?
Do all animals migrate when the weather changes?

explain.say: Some animals make a long journey every year. This is called migration.
Some birds fly to warmer places when it gets cold.

draw.text: Birds move when it gets cold

explain.say: Whales swim to other parts of the ocean to find food or have babies.
Some butterflies fly a very long way. Monarch butterflies can fly thousands of kilometres.
These journeys happen because the seasons change.
Swallows keep moving with the seasons. They leave in autumn and come back in spring.

draw.text: Real life: swallows leave in autumn

faq.a: Birds fly south to find warmer weather and more food.
asks: Where do birds go when it is cold?

faq.q: Do all animals move long distances?
faq.a: No. Only some animals migrate when the seasons change.
asks: Are there animals that never move?

faq.a: The changing seasons affect the food and weather for the animals.
asks: Why do animals need to move?

faq.a: Yes. Some butterflies fly thousands of kilometres looking for warmth and food.
asks: How far can a butterfly fly?

faq.a: Yes, whales swim to different areas of the ocean as their food moves.
asks: Do whales change their swimming spots?
Where do whales go in the ocean?

facts: Migration is a regular, long journey for animals.
Animals move to find food or warmer temperatures.
Seasons like winter and summer cause these movements.
Different animals, like birds and whales, migrate differently.

quiz.say: When do many birds fly to warmer places?
quiz.why: Cold weather means less food, so many birds fly to warmer places.

wrong.1: Sunny, warm weather is when the birds come back.
wrong.2: Rain comes in every season, so it is no sign to leave.

quiz.say: Why do whales swim to new parts of the ocean?
quiz.why: Whales travel to where their food is.

wrong.0: Whales are strong swimmers, so they choose where they go.
wrong.2: Whales live in the water, so they have no need for sand.

quiz.say: Animals make a long journey with the seasons. What is this called?
quiz.why: Migration is a long journey that animals make with the seasons.

wrong.0: Hibernation is a long winter sleep in one place.
wrong.1: Hatching is coming out of an egg.
